title: Fix the a11y Vitest config alias
notes: - Cause: `vitest.a11y.config.ts` mapped `@` to the repository root; the source
moved under `src/` on 2026-08-27 and the main config was updated, the a11y
one was not, so every a11y test failed to resolve `@/components/...`.
evidence: `pnpm test:a11y` before: 17 files failed, no tests; after: 17 files, 47 tests passed.
